parole.significato: A Polabian Slav; one of a number of Lechite tribes who lived along the Elbe river in what is now eastern Germany.
parole.testo: From the name of Polabian tribes, which in turn derives from the name of the Elbe river in Slavic languages (cp. Polish Łaba, Czech Labe), and possibly ultimately from Proto-Slavic *po.

parole.significato: The leader of a župa, or administrative unit, among various South Slavic peoples.
parole.testo: Of Slavic origin, from Proto-Slavic *županъ, from *župa (“area, district”).
